title: C: Command Pattern
description: Implement the Command design pattern using function pointers to support execute and undo operations.

steps.title: Command Interface
steps.description: Define a `Command` struct with function pointers for `execute` and `undo`. Implement concrete commands: `AddCommand` that adds two numbers and `PrintCommand` that prints a message. Create a command history array and execute 2 commands.
hints: AddCommand stores the operands and result in its state.

verification.failureMessage: Execute and undo the add command
